name: segmented-pill
title: Segmented Pill
description: A segmented control whose white pill slides to the selected item with a small squash, keyboard ready, as a motion variant beside the stock toggle group.
author: Daniel Belyi <https://github.com/Danilaa1>
docs:
Installed `SegmentedPill`. Import it from `@/components/ui/segmented-pill` and pass `items` (`value`, `label`, optional `disabled`) and an `aria-label`:

```tsx
const [value, setValue] = useState("overview");

<SegmentedPill
  aria-label="Section"
  items={[
    { value: "overview", label: "Overview" },
    { value: "activity", label: "Activity" },
    { value: "settings", label: "Settings" },
  ]}
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  animated
/>
```

`animated` slides the pill with a small stretch and squash (off by default, as upstream, and never under reduced motion). The same API ships on four bases: the default is upstream's own tablist (selection follows the arrow keys); `-radix` and `-base` are toggle groups (the arrows move focus, Space or Enter selects); `-aria` is a React Aria radio group (the arrows select). It sits beside shadcn's `toggle-group`, which it does not replace.

The styles live in the component file and are hoisted into `<head>` once. Theme it with `--segmented-pill-track`, `-pill`, `-text`, `-text-active`, `-focus` and `-shadow` (in the item's light and dark cssVars), and per instance with `--segmented-pill-radius`, `-gap`, `-padding`, `-duration`, `-easing` and `-font-family` (upstream's stack starts with Geist and falls back to the system sans; set it to `var(--font-sans)` to use your app font). Labels are any React node, so an icon from your icon set can sit beside the text.
